dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Falcate trailing edge exhibiting a concave spline curve that deepens towards the mid-section before tapering to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse pixel radius, lacking sharp terminal points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear anterior margin with a slope of approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum pixel base width to vertical height is approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible mottling and high-contrast depigmentation patches across the lateral surface; minor irregular indentations present along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-to-light marbling pattern covering the majority of the dorsal fin surface area.
